curatedFrom: Bounded direct sampling (getComputedStyle, 1440x900, Chromium) of https://www.tryprofound.com/ (pinned reference page, all module families except numbered steps) and https://www.tryprofound.com/features/agents (pinned reference for the numbered-step / quote / 4-up cell families). Corroboration only: /customers/plaid, /pricing, /enterprise. Raw samples: stardust/canon-source/samples/home.json; screenshots: stardust/canon-source/assets/screenshots/{home,features-agents,customers-plaid,pricing,enterprise}.png.
note: Pinned reference page: tryprofound.com home (container 1088px, radius 8px, 32px buttons). /features/agents shares the same system (verified: same container, radii, button spec, label 12px) and is pinned only for M14/M15/M16. USER PALETTE OVERRIDE (2026-10-11): Profound's black ground is replaced by stardust dark blue --navy #081e3d (from stardust.style styles.css), and Profound's white/near-white is replaced by #F4F2EC. Profound's neutral grey ladder (surfaces, hairlines, secondary text) is re-derived as mixes of #F4F2EC into #081e3d at the same luminance steps Profound uses over black, so every 'grey' is a navy tint. Each overridden value records its donor original under overrides{} for audit.

overrides.rule: black rgb(0,0,0) -> rgb(8,30,61) (#081e3d); white/near-white -> rgb(244,242,236) (#F4F2EC); greys -> mix(#F4F2EC into #081e3d, same % as donor grey over black)

userLayout2.request: hero too empty, spacing too airy; H1 and subtitle bigger

display.applied: 72px/76px, -2.4px (tracking ratio between Profound display -0.0225em and statement -0.0525em)

userHero3.request: H1 on one line; add the stars shader from stardust.style to the hero
userHero3.nebula: stardust.style blocks/hero/nebula.js fragment shader ported verbatim (renderers/nebula.client.js); palette: page #081e3d (reskin ground), navy #0f2c55, glow #1d3d68 (both lifted one step so the nebula reads on the navy ground), gold #f7ca6e, text #f4f2ec, coral #ed6f4c (stardust brand colours, scoped to the hero canvas only)

accentRev9.request: use stardust's own accent instead of Profound mint

v3.mono: system monospace for genuine code only (commands, hashes, paths) — replaces pill chips (#13)

palette.accentNote: stardust --gold #f7ca6e (user request rev 9) — replaces Profound's mint rgb(8, 255, 182) for bands, status, checks, meters
palette.chartNote: Profound chart/series colors sampled from home (bars, line chart legend, negative delta red) — used for mock data viz only

type.family: interVariable, "interVariable Fallback", "SF Pro Display", -apple-system, "system-ui", "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, "Open Sans", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
type.familyNote: Inter (rsms, SIL OFL 1.1) — open license, so the variable woff2 is loaded under the donor's own family name 'interVariable' from rsms.me; the full donor stack is the token string.

eyebrow.style: Profound step labels are sentence case, '[01] Use Templates' — bracketed number in mutedFg, label in headingFg

type.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

layout.grid: 1088px frame with vertical 1px dashed guides at the frame edges; sections separated by full-bleed 1px solid hairlines (border); feature cells are 1px-bordered grids (2-up, 3-up, 4-up) with 32px 24px cell padding

motifs: Dashed vertical guides framing the 1088px column, full-bleed hairlines between sections — the page reads as a ruled grid.
Product-UI mocks everywhere: app windows with sidebar/title bar, chat bubbles, node graphs, sheets with status pills — the product IS the illustration.
Soft radial light leak top-left of the hero; gradient bands (transparent -> surface1) mark the enterprise half.
Numbered steps '[01] Use Templates' as a ruled label row above a 32px step title, then a 2x2 bordered cell grid and a large mock.
Buttons are small (32px), quiet: one light primary, the rest muted secondary. Sentence case everywhere; no uppercase tracking.
